answer: An economy of autonomous agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a cryptographic reputation stake akin to tracing a rare digital sparrow across a vast, unforgeable verification river. Every transaction acts as a validating thread anchored to a verifiable compute history, rendering fake identities economically prohibitive. To manufacture a false node, an attacker must continuously expend real-world capital on cryptographic proof-of-work and historical bonding, making scale economically unviable.
